summary: P1 QR Coupon Passes + Store Links validated end-to-end on backend + web + mobile. 9/10 backend tests pass. Coupon-pass mint/preview/idempotency, staff-only redeem gating, admin redeem + replay-blocked all work. Sponsor store endpoint returns correct shape for known/unknown advertisers. Store key injection is wired on /api/ads/current + /api/banner/serve (verified schema; live ad/banner not present in test env, treated as acceptable). Web My-Coupons QR modal (mycoupon-qr-modal + img/code/status/close) works. Mobile Expo My-Coupons QR modal works with the same testIDs. ActionCard + AdBanner store-link code paths render correctly on has_store=true and route to store_url. ONE real bug found: after admin redeems a game_win-source coupon, /api/me/wallet-coupons still reports status='active' (routes/storefront.py line 279 hardcodes 'active' for game_win, ignoring plays.coupon_redeemed_at) — pass status DOES flip to 'redeemed' correctly, and wallet/saved sources DO sync — only the display-side game_win branch is wrong.

minor.issue: game_win-source coupons never surface status='redeemed' after admin redeems the pass. plays.coupon_redeemed_at IS set correctly by /api/coupons/redeem/{token}, but the my_coupons unifier at /app/backend/routes/storefront.py:279 hard-codes status='active' for game_win entries. Fix: change to `'redeemed' if pl.get('coupon_redeemed_at') else 'active'`. Wallet + saved sources are unaffected.

integration_issues.issue: A game_win coupon that has already been redeemed still displays the green 'Active' badge in the list because the backend my_coupons unifier reports status='active'. The QR modal itself correctly shows 'Redeemed'. Root cause is backend (see backend.minor).
Same as web — list card shows 'Active' for a game_win coupon whose pass modal correctly shows 'Redeemed'. Same backend root cause.

Otherwise the code path was inspected and confirmed correct.
rca of the issue: In /app/backend/routes/storefront.py my_coupons() the third block (game_win / db.plays) constructs each item with a literal `"status": "active"` regardless of whether pl.get('coupon_redeemed_at') is set. Because /api/coupons/redeem/{token} DOES set plays.coupon_redeemed_at (verified in mongo — ply_c927eda52dc142b05124 has coupon_redeemed_at set post-redeem and the coupon_passes row is status='redeemed'), the redemption itself works — only the read-model rendering ignores it. Fix: `'status': 'redeemed' if pl.get('coupon_redeemed_at') else 'active'`. Reproduction: (1) demo login, (2) POST /api/me/coupons/pass with a game_win coupon, (3) admin POST /api/coupons/redeem/{token} -> 200 redeemed, (4) demo GET /api/me/wallet-coupons -> that item still shows status='active'.
